map.心衰NYHA分级与六分钟步行评估器 使用指南: Heart Failure NYHA Grading and Six-Minute Walk Evaluator User Guide
map.纽约心脏病协会(NYHA)心功能分级 + 六分钟步行试验(6MWT)综合评估心衰: New York Heart Association (NYHA) cardiac function grading plus the Six-Minute Walk Test (6MWT) to comprehensively assess heart failure severity and prognosis
map.NYHA 心功能分级：I 级日常无限制；II 级日常活动轻度受限；III 级明显: NYHA cardiac function grading: class I no limitation in daily activity; class II mild limitation; class III marked limitation (symptoms with less than ordinary activity); class IV symptoms even at rest, reflecting heart failure severity.
map.6 分钟步行距离：>450 m 轻度、300–450 m 中度、<300 m 重: 6-minute walk distance: over 450 m is mild, 300-450 m is moderate, under 300 m is severely limited, adding objective exercise tolerance.
map.再评估与康复：治疗前后 NYHA 与 6MWT 变化用于疗效与康复强度调整，分级: Re-evaluation and rehabilitation: the change in NYHA and 6MWT before and after treatment guides efficacy and rehabilitation intensity, and a rise in class signals deterioration.
map.默认数据演练（心功能与运动耐量评估）: Default data walkthrough (cardiac function and exercise tolerance assessment)
map.：输入：NYHA II 级、6 分钟步行 380 m、平地走百米气促、平路可停。: Input: NYHA class II, 6-minute walk 380 m, breathlessness after 100 m on flat ground, able to stop on level ground. Tool output: functional class II (mild limitation), exercise tolerance moderately limited (300-450), recommendations to optimize medication plus phase II rehabilitation and retest the 6MWT in 3 months. Note: the class relies on subjective symptoms while the 6MWT adds objectivity.
map.按症状对活动限制：I 无限制、II 日常活动轻受限、III 明显受限（轻微即喘）: Activity limits are graded by symptoms: I no limitation, II mild limitation in daily activity, III marked limitation (short of breath on slight effort), IV short of breath at rest. This is a symptom-based grading affected by subjectivity and comorbidities, so combine it with objective tests.
map.6 分钟步行测什么？: What does the 6-minute walk test measure?
map.在平直走廊尽速行走 6 分钟测距离，反映亚极量运动耐量：>450 m 轻、300: Walk as fast as possible for 6 minutes along a flat corridor and measure the distance, reflecting submaximal exercise tolerance: over 450 m mild, 300-450 m moderate, under 300 m severe. Used for heart failure rehabilitation baselines, efficacy and prognosis; simple and safe.
map.提示心衰恶化，应复诊调整药物（如利尿剂、ARNI/β 阻滞/ SGLT2i 等）: It signals worsening heart failure; return to the clinic to adjust medication (such as diuretics, ARNI / beta blockers / SGLT2i), investigate triggers (infection, anemia, arrhythmia), and adjust rehabilitation intensity under monitoring; a sudden worsening with breathing difficulty requires emergency care.
